name: Data Analyzer: Every documented dictionary type name maps to one of the five checked types
objective: Proves common dictionary type words (integer, text, date, categorical, ...) are all understood and mapped to int, float, str, bool or datetime. Runs once per target type.
precondition: No server needed; the shared type-mapping function is called directly.

steps.action: Map each listed name to its checked type.
steps.data: int: int, INTEGER, ' Int64 ', bigint. float: float, number, Numeric, decimal, double, float64. str: str, string, TEXT, varchar, categorical, category, dropdown, radio. bool: bool, boolean. datetime: datetime, date, Timestamp, time, datetime64, date_ymd, datetime_dmy
steps.expected: Every name in a group maps to that group's type (capitals and surrounding spaces are tolerated).

name: Data Analyzer: Unknown or empty type names are not mapped
objective: Proves unrecognised values are reported as 'no mapping' instead of being guessed. Runs once per value.
precondition: No server needed; the shared type-mapping function is called directly.

steps.data: 'array', 'calc', empty text, nothing, the number 5, and the list ['int']

name: Data Analyzer: Whole-dictionary mapping drops unmappable columns and lists them
objective: Proves a dictionary with one odd column is still usable and the odd column is named for reporting.
precondition: No server needed; the shared function is called directly.

steps.data: a = date, b = array, c = Integer
steps.expected: Result keeps a as datetime and c as int, and lists b as the column that could not be mapped.

name: Data Analyzer: Date-like type names are really checked as dates
objective: Proves a column declared 'date', 'Timestamp' or 'datetime64' is checked, so a bad date is reported. Runs for 3 names on both routes (6 runs).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Analyse a made-up CSV with one valid and one invalid date, declaring the column with each name, on both the file-upload and inline-data routes.
steps.expected: HTTP 200, and the data-type issues list includes an issue for column 'visit'.

name: Data Analyzer: Every family of type names is accepted by both routes
objective: Proves the type names integer, INT64, number, string, categorical and boolean are not rejected. Runs 6 names on both routes. It checks only the status code.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Analyse a made-up two-row numeric CSV declaring column x with each name.
steps.expected: HTTP 200 each time. (No check on what was reported.)

name: Data Analyzer: An unknown type name gets HTTP 422 that names the column but not the bad value
objective: Proves a truly unknown type is refused clearly and the offending text is not echoed back. Runs on both routes.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Analyse a made-up CSV declaring column x with the type 'SECRET-TYPE-NAME'.
steps.expected: HTTP 422; the message contains the column name 'x' in quotes; the response text does not contain SECRET-TYPE-NAME.

name: Data Analyzer: The page maps dictionary types and shows a note for a column type it cannot check
objective: Proves an analysis still succeeds when one dictionary type (array) cannot be mapped, and the user sees which column was not checked.
precondition: Web page loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; the page's call to the service is routed to the in-process server; a private temporary cache folder is used. No network. The AI dictionary reader is replaced by a canned answer with four fields: visit_date (date), count (integer), arm (categorical), tags (array).

steps.action: Upload a dummy dictionary and a made-up 2-row CSV, then press Run analysis.
steps.expected: The page raises no exception and shows no 'Analysis failed' error.

steps.action: Read the stored results and the warnings.
steps.expected: The not-checked list is exactly ['tags'], and a warning says '1 column type(s) could not be checked' and names tags.

name: Data Analyzer: Each built-in demo dictionary analyses with its demo data without an error
objective: Proves the shipped demo dictionaries all use type names the system understands. Runs for 5 demo pairs.
precondition: Web page loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; the page's call to the service is routed to the in-process server; a private temporary cache folder is used. No network. No AI model is needed.

steps.action: Select each demo data set and its demo dictionary and press Run analysis.
steps.data: Pairs: CSV Western; CSV Asian; JSON Mixed; CSV Clinical Trial; REDCap Clinical (synthetic, with branching logic)
steps.expected: No exception, no 'Analysis failed' error, and the results report more than zero rows.
